import argparse
from fate import component, pipeline
from fate.components.core import Reader, DataTransform, Intersection, HeteroNN, Evaluation

def main(config_path):
    # Load config
    import yaml
    with open(config_path, "r") as f:
        conf = yaml.safe_load(f)
    guest = conf["role"]["guest"][0]
    host = conf["role"]["host"][0]
    backend = conf["backend"]
    work_mode = conf["work_mode"]

    # Define pipeline
    pipe = pipeline.Pipeline()
    pipe.set_initiator(role='guest', party_id=guest)
    pipe.set_roles(guest=guest, host=host)

    # Reader component
    reader_0 = Reader(name="reader_0")
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        table=conf["data"]["guest_train"])
    reader_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        table=conf["data"]["host_train"])

    # DataTransform component
    data_transform_0 = DataTransform(name="data_transform_0")
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role='guest', party_id=guest).component_param(
        with_label=True, output_format="dense")
    data_transform_0.get_party_instance(role='host', party_id=host).component_param(
        with_label=False)

    # Intersection component
    intersect_0 = Intersection(name="intersect_0")

    # HeteroNN component
    hetero_nn_0 = HeteroNN(name="hetero_nn_0",
        epochs=10,
        batch_size=64,
        learning_rate=0.01,
        interactive_layer_lr=0.01,
        optimizer="Adam",
        config_type="nn",
        early_stop={"early_stop": "diff", "eps": 1e-4},
        callback_param={"callbacks": ["EarlyStopping", "ModelCheckpoint"], "save_freq": 1},
        guest_bottom_model={"nn_define": [
            {"layer": "Dense", "units": 64, "activation": "relu"},
            {"layer": "Dense", "units": 32, "activation": "relu"}
        ]},
        host_bottom_model={"nn_define": [
            {"layer": "Dense", "units": 64, "activation": "relu"},
            {"layer": "Dense", "units": 32, "activation": "relu"}
        ]},
        interactive_layer_define={"layer": "InteractiveLayer"},
        guest_top_model={"nn_define": [
            {"layer": "Dense", "units": 1, "activation": "sigmoid"}
        ]}
    )

    # Evaluation component
    evaluation_0 = Evaluation(name="evaluation_0", eval_type="binary")

    # Add components to pipeline
    pipe.add_component(reader_0)
    pipe.add_component(data_transform_0, data=reader_0.output.data)
    pipe.add_component(intersect_0, data=data_transform_0.output.data)
    pipe.add_component(hetero_nn_0, data=intersect_0.output.data)
    pipe.add_component(evaluation_0, data=hetero_nn_0.output.data)

    # Compile and fit pipeline
    pipe.compile()
    pipe.fit()

    # Print HeteroNN summary
    summary = pipe.get_component("hetero_nn_0").get_summary()
    print("HeteroNN Summary:", summary)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="FATE HeteroNN Pipeline")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=str, required=True, help="Path to config yaml")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    main(args.config)
